div.head: VII Atr Rubr.
div.ab: (Ut de omni caruca detur denarius sanctę Dei ecclesię, et tainus decimet quicquid habet [De denario s. e. dando et decimatione thaynorum Br]. II. De ieiunio et feriatione III dierum ante festum sancti Michaelis. III. Quid pro rege [Q. regi Br] et populo omni die sit cantandum. IIII. De reddendis omnibus consuetudinibus sanctę Dei ecclesię [De cons. s. Dei e. r. Br]. V. Ne quis uendatur extra patriam. VI. De robaria. VII [8]. De elemosinis et rectitudinibus ecclesię.)

[I. Ut de omni caruca detur denarius sanctae Dei ecclesiae, et tainus decimet quicquid habet. II. De ieiunio et feriatione III dierum ante festum sancti Michaelis. III. Quid pro rege et populo omni die sit cantandum. IIII. De reddendis omnibus consuetudinibus sanctae Dei ecclesiae. V. Ne quis vendatur extra patriam. VI. De robaria. VII. De elemosinis et rectitudinibus ecclesiae.]

[I.That a penny should be given to the holy church of God from every plough-land, and a tenth of whatever he has. II. Of the fast for 3 days before the holy feast of St. Michael. III.What should be sung every day for the king and the people. IIII. On paying all customary dues of the holy church of God. V. Let no one be sold abroad. VI. On theft. VII. On almsgiving and the rightful dues of the church.]
div.note: Latin only (Quadripartitus, after Dunsæte; text from T, spelling from M, compared with HkBr). The rubric list is missing from T, so perhaps drawn only from the Latin text and added in the latest Quadripartitus edition (MHkBr). No German translation. VII Atr dates 992–1011 (issued at Bath); its Old English wording can be reconstructed from VIIa Atr (below).; F: corrected against Liebermann, Gesetze I (date in the running heads), October 2026 (was “992–1011; no evidence of exact date (Robertson); 1009 (Whitelock, Wormald); Bath”, now “992–1011 (Liebermann); no evidence of exact date (Robertson); 1009 (Whitelock, Wormald); Bath”); F: corrected against Liebermann, Gesetze I (date at the head of the text); Wormald, Making of English Law I; Whitelock, English Historical Documents I, October 2026 (was “992–1011 (Liebermann); no evidence of exact date (Robertson); 1009 (Whitelock, Wormald); Bath”, now “992–1011 (Liebermann, I p. 260); no evidence of exact date (Robertson); probably 1009 (Whitelock, EHD p. 452); 1009 (Wormald, MEL p. 331); Bath”); BQ: page of each of Liebermann’s texts and of his German, checked against Liebermann, Gesetze I (our double-read transcription), October 2026 (e.g. was “(empty)”, now “Q 260”; 28 rows of VII Atr); V: page of the modern editor’s text / translation, checked against Robertson (translation on the facing page), October 2026 (e.g. was “108”, now “108 / 109”; 28 rows of VII Atr)

note.seg: Hinter Dunsæte; Text aus T, Orthographie aus M; verglichen: HkBr, der Adhuc de legibus Ethelredi überschreibt.
After Dunsæte; text from T, spelling from M; collated: HkBr, which gives the heading Adhuc de legibus Ethelredi.
Rubrikenliste fehlt T [ist also vielleicht ohne Angelsächsische Vorlage nur dem Lateinischen Texte entflossen und nur der jüngsten Quadripartitus-Ausgabe (MHkBr) hinzugefügt].
List of rubrics missing in T [it therefore perhaps derives, without an Anglo-Saxon original, solely from the Latin text and was added only to the latest edition of the Quadripartitus (MHkBr)].
